verdict.rationale: Crawl4AI is an open-source library on GitHub with "no forced API keys, no paywalls." It ships an optimized Docker image with a FastAPI server for self-deployment, and its docs include a dedicated self-hosting section. Community posts independently call it an open-source library and describe one-click Docker setups. missing for 10: explicit license terms and in-depth self-hosting deployment details (scaling, configuration) in the evidence.
